//! codex-stub: a stand-in for the `codex` program, used to see exactly how a caller starts it.
//!
//! It is a real executable (the Codex SDK starts the program with no shell, and on Windows Node cannot start a
//! `.cmd` launcher that way), with no dependencies, so `rustc codex-stub.rs` builds it.
//!
//! It takes no options of its own and reads nothing from its environment, so that neither its argument list nor
//! its environment is changed by the capture. What it does comes from a folder called `plan` next to the
//! executable:
//!
//!   plan/record.txt       the path of the JSON file to write (required to record anything)
//!   plan/stdout.jsonl     lines to write to stdout once stdin has ended (optional)
//!   plan/stderr.txt       text to write to stderr before exiting (optional)
//!   plan/exit.txt         the exit code (optional, default 0)
//!   plan/sleep_ms.txt     how long to wait after writing stdout, before exiting (optional)
//!   plan/alive.txt        the path of a file to rewrite every 20 ms with the time since start (optional): what
//!                         it last holds is when the process was ended from outside
//!
//! The record: {argv, cwd, pid, env: {name: value}, stdin: {chunks: [{at_ms, bytes, text}], eof_at_ms, text}}.
//! argv is everything after the program's own name. Offsets are milliseconds since the stub started.

use std::fs;
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

fn json_string(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len() + 2);
    out.push('"');
    for c in s.chars() {
        match c {
            '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
            '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
            '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
            '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
            c => out.push(c),
        }
    }
    out.push('"');
    out
}

fn read_plan(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Option<String> {
    fs::read_to_string(dir.join(name)).ok()
}

fn main() {
    let started = Instant::now();
    let exe = std::env::current_exe().unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."));
    let plan = exe.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new(".")).join("plan");

    // A heartbeat, so the caller can tell when this process was ended from outside.
    if let Some(alive) = read_plan(&plan, "alive.txt") {
        let alive = alive.trim().to_string();
        if !alive.is_empty() {
            std::thread::spawn(move || loop {
                let _ = fs::write(&alive, format!("{}", started.elapsed().as_millis()));
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
            });
        }
    }

    // Read stdin to its end, noting when each piece arrived.
    let mut chunks: Vec<(u128, Vec<u8>)> = Vec::new();
    let mut all: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    let mut stdin = std::io::stdin();
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 64 * 1024];
    let eof_at;
    loop {
        match stdin.read(&mut buf) {
            Ok(0) => {
                eof_at = started.elapsed().as_millis();
                break;
            }
            Ok(n) => {
                chunks.push((started.elapsed().as_millis(), buf[..n].to_vec()));
                all.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);
            }
            Err(_) => {
                eof_at = started.elapsed().as_millis();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(record) = read_plan(&plan, "record.txt") {
        let record = record.trim();
        if !record.is_empty() {
            let argv: Vec<String> = std::env::args_os().skip(1).map(|a| a.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).collect();
            let cwd = std::env::current_dir().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default();
            let mut env: Vec<(String, String)> = std::env::vars_os()
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string_lossy().into_owned(), v.to_string_lossy().into_owned()))
                .collect();
            env.sort();
            let mut out = String::new();
            out.push_str("{\n  \"argv\": [");
            out.push_str(&argv.iter().map(|a| json_string(a)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "));
            out.push_str("],\n  \"cwd\": ");
            out.push_str(&json_string(&cwd));
            out.push_str(&format!(",\n  \"pid\": {},\n  \"env\": {{", std::process::id()));
            out.push_str(
                &env.iter().map(|(k, v)| format!("\n    {}: {}", json_string(k), json_string(v))).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","),
            );
            out.push_str("\n  },\n  \"stdin\": {\n    \"chunks\": [");
            out.push_str(
                &chunks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(at, bytes)| {
                        format!(
                            "{{\"at_ms\": {}, \"bytes\": {}, \"text\": {}}}",
                            at,
                            bytes.len(),
                            json_string(&String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes))
                        )
                    })
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(", "),
            );
            out.push_str(&format!("],\n    \"eof_at_ms\": {},\n    \"bytes\": {},\n    \"text\": ", eof_at, all.len()));
            out.push_str(&json_string(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&all)));
            out.push_str("\n  }\n}\n");
            let _ = fs::write(record, out);
        }
    }

    if let Some(lines) = read_plan(&plan, "stdout.jsonl") {
        let stdout = std::io::stdout();
        let mut w = stdout.lock();
        let _ = w.write_all(lines.as_bytes());
        let _ = w.flush();
    }
    if let Some(ms) = read_plan(&plan, "sleep_ms.txt").and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<u64>().ok()) {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(ms));
    }
    if let Some(text) = read_plan(&plan, "stderr.txt") {
        let _ = std::io::stderr().write_all(text.as_bytes());
        let _ = std::io::stderr().flush();
    }
    let code = read_plan(&plan, "exit.txt").and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    std::process::exit(code);
}
